info_text_1:
Welcome to PIXELTOWN!
Hello, leader! Welcome to the world of PIXELTOWN, a place where your
decisions will shape a new metropolis from the ground up. Your adventure
begins here, with initial resources, pristine land, and endless potential.

In PIXELTOWN, you are the mayor, architect, and visionary of your city.
Your main mission is to transform this land into a prosperous, vibrant,
and happy city. You will manage your budget, invest in new constructions,
attract citizens, and ensure their needs are met.
Will you build a quiet neighborhood, a business hub, or a green park?
Each building and coin invested will directly impact your city's growth.
info_text_2:
A Glimpse into the Future (Beta Version)
PIXELTOWN is steadily evolving. We are actively developing richer economic
systems, new events, buildings, minigames, and deep customization.

Project Goals
One of our main future goals is to stop relying on external Python
libraries and develop our own built-in custom libraries and tools.

Greetings
Lead Developer: Raúl Salas Sahuquillo

Contributors
Leanna Lee
